generatedBy: tools/content/geography/repair_model.mjs (deterministic; regenerate, do not edit by hand)
precedence: Entries apply in order over the drawing's surface; a later entry wins where entries overlap.
note: Requirement R-18: the engine wraps the map, so the bands x < 0.04, x > 0.96, y < 0.025 and y > 0.975 are open sea. The band polygons follow the natural coasts of the repaired model (seeded fractal noise per edge id). The undrawn_land entries are the land of the model that no sheet draws: the land the layout generated (the top and bottom 128 rows, the Northern Wastes) and land past the paper of every sheet its region is drawn on; the `clip` of each sheet in the model says where the import reads it. The layout_* entries (each with the feature and the reason) force the model's land or sea where the warped drawing disagrees with the owner-approved layout of 17 and 18 October 2026 (docs/generation/assumptions.md), which rearranged and reshaped the sheets: there the model wins; they come from tools/content/data/geography/layout_overrides.json (layout_overrides.mjs).
